mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content_reports (target_type, target_id, reporter_id, reason, detail, status) VALUES (#{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{reporterId}, #{reason}, #{detail}, 'pending')
mapper.sql: r.id, r.target_type AS targetType, r.target_id AS targetId, r.reporter_id AS reporterId, COALESCE(rp.nickname, ru.username) AS reporterName, CASE WHEN r.target_type = 'log' THEN COALESCE(l.title, CONCAT('日志 #', l.id)) WHEN r.target_type = 'comment' THEN CONCAT('评论 #', lc.id) ELSE CONCAT(r.target_type, ' #', r.target_id) END AS targetTitle, CASE WHEN r.target_type = 'log' THEN l.content WHEN r.target_type = 'comment' THEN lc.content ELSE NULL END AS targetContent, r.reason, r.detail, r.status, r.handler_id AS handlerId, COALESCE(hp.nickname, hu.username) AS handlerName, r.handle_note AS handleNote, r.handled_at AS handledAt, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt

FROM content_reports r JOIN users ru ON ru.id = r.reporter_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles rp ON rp.user_id = ru.id LEFT JOIN users hu ON hu.id = r.handler_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles hp ON hp.user_id = hu.id LEFT JOIN travel_logs l ON r.target_type = 'log' AND l.id = r.target_id LEFT JOIN log_comments lc ON r.target_type = 'comment' AND lc.id = r.target_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY CASE r.status WHEN 'pending' THEN 1 WHEN 'handled' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT id, target_type AS targetType, target_id AS targetId, reporter_id AS reporterId, reason, detail, status, handler_id AS handlerId, handle_note AS handleNote, handled_at AS handledAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM content_reports WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE content_reports SET status = #{status}, handler_id = #{handlerId}, handle_note = #{handleNote}, handled_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
